posts.text:
Exactly right @TimSheehyMT. 

That’s why we must pass @SenJohnKennedy’s No Shutdown Paychecks for Politicians Act. 

Members of Congress taking a paycheck while hardworking Americans suffer is unconscionable.


Tim Sheehy (@TimSheehyMT)

Democrats shutting down the government for their own political purposes is a disgrace. 

If federal employees aren’t getting paid, neither should members of Congress. Let’s get this done.





— https://nitter.net/TimSheehyMT/status/2054239261231132864#m

It was a honor to receive The Edwin C. Whitehead Award for Medical Research Advocacy from @ResearchAmerica!
 
Medical research is fundamental to our nation’s strength, and I am proud to be a partner as we fuel American innovation that opens doors for funding cures.

Today, I recognized four Alabama heroes who made the ultimate sacrifice in the line of duty over this past year: Conservation Enforcement Officer Shawn Nixon, Police Officer Dallas Hinton, Corporal David Hathcock, and Lieutenant Mark Meadows. We will never forget their courage, service, and sacrifice of the men and women who risk their lives every day when they leave their homes so we may safely return to ours.

Video

The last time I spoke to the Artemis II crew, they were about to return to Earth! Deeply grateful to recognize their historic mission in person today in Washington. Their legacy and contributions to deep space exploration will live on for generations.

Americans deserve an opportunity to own a home. The Senate passed a bill to help more families do just that. 

The House should pass the ROAD to Housing Act and send it straight to @POTUS’s desk.
.@POTUS is right, Wesley is hard to miss whether he’s in the Oval Office or on the football field! Great to join President Trump for an event celebrating and supporting moms today.

.@POTUS is setting up moms and families for success with the launch of moms.gov.

Visit today to learn more and access an incredible set of resources!

Video

Rural states like my home state of Alabama face significant healthcare challenges, specifically access to maternal care. Supporting research to reduce maternal mortality rates and supporting moms throughout their motherhood journeys is a top priority of mine and this Administration’s.

Video

The affordability and accessibility of childcare should never an impediment for Americans looking to re-enter the workforce.

I was proud to lead efforts in the Working Families @TaxCuts to modernize and multiply childcare tax credits, for the first time since President Reagan’s term, to help address this crisis.

Video

Sickening. No one should have to endure what these victims’ families are facing.

The more we learn about how AI companions talk to our young people, the more it’s clear Congress needs to take action. Big Tech will continue to put profits over the American people until we hold them accountable.


Ben Goggin (@BenjaminGoggin)

NEW: ChatGPT advised the FSU shooter that a mass shooting would get more attention from media if it involved several children, according to a new lawsuit against OpenAI
nbc

Moms are the heartbeat of our families, communities, and country.

Proud to join @POTUS, @DrOzCMS, @SecKennedy, and several others today to launch moms.gov and continue expanding support for women and families through every stage of motherhood.

Video

I’m deeply grateful for this bipartisan initiative. Alabama has one of the highest maternal mortality rates in the nation and more than 1/3 of our counties are classified as maternity care deserts which is why improving maternal health outcomes is a top priority for me. 

I will continue fighting to support families and working to ensure moms have access to the care they need.


Heartland Forward (@HeartlandFwd)

This Mother's Day, Olivia Walton joined NBC’s @MeetThePress to launch #HealthyMomsH

Grateful for the law enforcement officers across Alabama and our nation who work tirelessly to protect and serve our families and communities. 

Thank you for your service and sacrifice this National Police Week and every day.

This is an incredible resource for mothers. Visit moms.gov today!



Karoline Leavitt (@PressSec)

Moms.Gov 👶🏼 moms.gov/




— https://nitter.net/PressSec/status/2053856757345095938#m

Looking forward to joining @POTUS this morning to discuss expanding access to fertility coverage for hardworking American families. Grateful for his leadership to help loving parents start and grow their families.


Acting Secretary Keith Sonderling (@Sonderling47)

This Mother’s Day, at @USDOL, we’re proposing a new rule with @HHSGov and @USTreasury to make fertility care more accessible and affordable for American families.

To learn more visit our new Fertility Benefits website: beta.dol.gov/
